description: Create a complete Romanian e-Factura (UBL 2.1 CIUS-RO XML) from simple data: invoice number, dates, seller and buyer CUI, lines (name, quantity, unit, price without VAT, VAT rate e.g. 21 or 11), optional IBAN. Company names, addresses, county codes, Bucharest sectors and VAT status are filled from ANAF; totals and VAT are computed; the XML is validated before it is returned. Paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only when a valid invoice is returned. Other currencies: add 'currency': 'EUR' (BNR rate used unless you pass exchange_rate). Example invoice: {"number": "FCT-0001", "issue_date": "2026-10-24", "due_date": "2026-11-23", "seller": {"cui": "RO12345678"}, "buyer": {"cui": "87654321"}, "payment": {"iban": "RO49AAAA1B31007593840000"}, "lines": [{"name": "Servicii consultanta", "quantity": 10, "unit": "ore", "price": 150, "vat_rate": 21}]}
